messages:
mina: quick idea — prototype a tiny "mini audit" panel inside Routing > Policies showing last 5 changes (actor, short diff, reason link).
raj: 👍 useful for quick triage. do we show full diffs or summaries?
taylor: prefer summaries in table + 'view full event' modal. full payload available via ndjson export.
erica: security note — don't surface secrets in diffs (api keys, tokens). need field-level redaction flags.
mina: agreed. API proposal: GET /internal/audit/events?resource=route&limit=5 returns events array with event_id, ts, actor_display, op, path, before_summary, after_summary, reason_id.
raj: question: actor_display vs actor_id — for console show display, but exports keep actor_id/email for compliance.
taylor: server-side RBAC should gate the extra fields. clients just render what they get.
erica: also require a short justification on route policy changes when role!=engineer. store justification_id + text. searchable.
mina: UX question — inline collapsed diffs or open modal? i lean inline collapsed with 2-3 changed lines and a "view full" link.
raj: add telemetry: audit_panel_view, audit_view_diff_click, audit_export_initiated. include sample metric labels: resource=route, env=prod.
devex-bot: created ticket INT-4587: "mini audit panel for routing" — https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/INT-4587
ops-bot: deploy: routing-service v1.12.0 promoted to prod (sha: a1b2c3) :tada:
mina: API shape debate: single /api/audit/events endpoint with resource filter vs per-resource endpoints. pros/cons?
taylor: single endpoint = simpler client and unified telemetry. per-resource = stricter RBAC and easier optimization.
raj: compromise: single endpoint but require resource param and enforce RBAC server-side. add signed mask for PII fields depending on caller role.
erica: retention/compliance: some customers need 7yr retention. export workflow must support long-term retention requests and a signed export audit trail.
mina: export format: NDJSON, 1 event per line, include a minimal header object optionally as first line? prefer pure ndjson (no extra header).
taylor: sample event shape (console-friendly):
```
{
  "event_id": "evt_01F...",
  "ts": "2026-03-15T18:22:00Z",
  "actor_display": "Raj Patel",
  "op": "update",
  "path": "routing.policies[42].quota",
  "before_summary": "rate=100/min",
  "after_summary": "rate=50/min",
  "reason_id": "just_123"
}
```
mina: and full export event would include actor_id, actor_email, full before/after blobs, justification_text, request_id, source_ip, and service_version.
erica: PII redaction modes: display_only, include_pseudonymized, include_full (only for compliance-role). document in API docs.
raj: we should also bubble the audit link into rollout UX: when rolling a policy change, show the audit event in the rollout toast and link to the mini panel.
taylor: agreed — that ties traceability to rollouts. also add a small "policy change rate" chart on the panel (last 30d).
mina: next steps: 1) design mockup (mina) 2) API contract draft (raj) 3) telemetry + RBAC plan (erica) 4) ticket INT-4587 to track.
mina: anyone object to proceeding with that plan?
erica: no objections from security side, just require redaction options in the contract.
raj: +1 from platform. i'll draft the contract.
taylor: i'll add telemetry counters and a quick console stub.
mina: sweet — will post mockup later today. thanks!
